connector.name: Orcpin
connector.registryDescription: Paid x402 facts for AI agents: on-chain snapshots, endpoint reliability, trade math, free directory
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package orcpin-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the npraught account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: ORCPIN_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Private key (0x + 64 hex) of a dedicated, low-balance Base wallet holding a few dollars of USDC. Used only to sign gasless x402 payment authorizations; never transmitted.

env.name: ORCPIN_TOOLSETS
env.description: Optional comma-separated subset of tools to expose: "defi" (chain + endpoint-reliability tools) and/or "trading" (trade-log calculators). Default: all eight tools.

env.name: X402_NETWORK
env.description: x402 network id. Default eip155:8453 (Base mainnet).
